programs.title: Dhamaal
programs.desc: Four slack and vagabond conmen learn about a hidden treasure from a dying thief and race against time to claim it. Meanwhile, they are also being pursued by a determined police inspector who is hell-bent on finding the treasure and keeping it all to himself.

programs.title: Khakee
programs.desc: DCP Anant and his team are assigned to escort an alleged terrorist from Chandangarh to Mumbai. His seemingly simple mission turns into a deadly encounter of survival when a rogue ex-cop turned criminal hinders his way.

programs.title: Mickey Virus
programs.desc: Two police officers approach a street smart hacker, Mickey Arora, to help them solve a case. Mickey, along with his friends sets out to crack the case and unravels a complex web of deceit, conspiracy, and danger.
